findings.name: Setup checklist counts 2 codes ready after adding a single voucher code
findings.summary: The checklist step says '2 codes ready' while the Voucher codes table contains only the single code 'agent5-codes'. (on /discounts/vouchers/add)
findings.expected: The checklist step should say '1 code ready' to match the single code in the codes table and the '1 of 3' completed-step counter.
findings.actual: The checklist step says '2 codes ready' while the Voucher codes table contains only the single code 'agent5-codes'.
reproSteps: Go to /discounts/vouchers/add (Create Voucher).
In the 'Voucher codes' card click 'Add code'.
Choose 'Manual code', type agent5-codes in 'Enter code' and click 'Confirm'.
Look at the 'Voucher codes' table: it lists exactly one code, agent5-codes.
Scroll up to the 'Set up this voucher' checklist and read the 'Add a code' step's summary line.

findings.name: Empty voucher code is accepted and saved in the Create voucher codes table
findings.summary: The empty code is accepted: the Voucher codes table gets a row with a blank Code, status 'Draft', the checklist moves to '1 of 3' ('Add a code' done, 'Next up: Assign channels'), and a second empty Confirm is rejected as 'Code already exists' — proving an empty code was stored. The step subtitle even says '2 codes ready' while the table lists one blank row. (on /discounts/vouchers/add)
findings.expected: The dialog refuses an empty code with a validation message next to the field (as it does for a duplicate) and no code row is added; the setup checklist must not count 'Add a code' as done.
findings.actual: The empty code is accepted: the Voucher codes table gets a row with a blank Code, status 'Draft', the checklist moves to '1 of 3' ('Add a code' done, 'Next up: Assign channels'), and a second empty Confirm is rejected as 'Code already exists' — proving an empty code was stored. The step subtitle even says '2 codes ready' while the table lists one blank row.
reproSteps: Open /discounts/vouchers/add (Create voucher).
In the 'Voucher codes' card click '+ Add code'.
Choose 'Manual code' in the dropdown; the dialog 'Enter Voucher Code' opens with an empty 'Enter code' field (placeholder 'Enter code').
Type nothing and click 'Confirm'.
Look at the 'Voucher codes' table (screenshot: a row with an empty Code cell and status Draft) and at the checklist above, which now reads '1 of 3' with 'Add a code' marked done.
Click '+ Add code' > 'Manual code' > 'Confirm' with the field still empty: the dialog now answers 'Code already exists'.

findings.name: Save with an invalid discount percentage shows "Couldn't create voucher" but the voucher is created anyway
findings.summary: The VoucherCreate mutation runs before the channel-listing validation, so a voucher is created with no discount value and no channels while the person is told the voucher could not be created. The list shows the half-made voucher ('1 code', Active, Offer '–') and clicking Save again after fixing 101 would create a second one. (on /discounts/vouchers/add)
findings.expected: When Save is refused ("Couldn't create voucher - Check the highlighted fields and try again") nothing should be created, and the voucher list should not gain a new incomplete voucher. The user fixes the field and saves once.
findings.actual: The VoucherCreate mutation runs before the channel-listing validation, so a voucher is created with no discount value and no channels while the person is told the voucher could not be created. The list shows the half-made voucher ('1 code', Active, Offer '–') and clicking Save again after fixing 101 would create a second one.
reproSteps: Sign in as admin@example.com and open Discounts > Vouchers > Create voucher (/discounts/vouchers/add).
In 'Voucher codes' click 'Add code', choose 'Manual code', type agent4-disc1 and click Confirm.
In the Availability card click Manage, tick 'Select all channels' (Channel-PLN + Channel-USD) and click 'Confirm (2 channels)'.
Scroll to 'Discount amount' > 'Percentage off, per channel', type 101 in Channel-PLN and 100 in Channel-USD.
Click Save. A field error 'Invalid percentage value' appears and the toast 'Couldn't create voucher - Check the highlighted fields and try again.' is shown.
Open Discounts > Vouchers and search for 'agent4'.

A new voucher row exists: name '1 code', Status 'Active', Offer '–', Scope 'Entire order'. Open it: it shows 'Finish setting up this voucher 1 of 3', code agent4-disc1 present, 'Voucher in 0 of 2 channels', no discount value.

findings.name: Enabling "Minimum quantity of items" silently turns off "Minimal order value" — the two requirements cannot be combined
findings.summary: Turning on 'Minimum quantity of items' switches 'Minimal order value' off and hides its Channel-PLN / Channel-USD amount fields. Turning 'Minimal order value' back on switches 'Minimum quantity of items' off and hides its quantity field. Only one of the two requirements can ever be enabled at a time; the two switches behave as mutually exclusive although nothing on the page says so. (on /discounts/vouchers/add (Requirements section))
findings.expected: Both requirements are separate optional controls described as 'Optional thresholds customers must meet before the voucher can be applied'; turning on 'Minimum quantity of items' should leave 'Minimal order value' on with its per-channel amounts, so a voucher can require both a minimum order value and a minimum item quantity.
findings.actual: Turning on 'Minimum quantity of items' switches 'Minimal order value' off and hides its Channel-PLN / Channel-USD amount fields. Turning 'Minimal order value' back on switches 'Minimum quantity of items' off and hides its quantity field. Only one of the two requirements can ever be enabled at a time; the two switches behave as mutually exclusive although nothing on the page says so.
reproSteps: Go to /discounts/vouchers/add
In the right-hand Availability panel click Manage channels, tick Select all channels (Channel-PLN, Channel-USD) and click Confirm
In the left-hand section list click Requirements
Turn on the 'Minimal order value' switch and type 25 in Channel-PLN and 100 in Channel-USD
Turn on the 'Minimum quantity of items' switch
Observe both switches and the amount fields
Turn 'Minimal order value' on again, then turn 'Minimum quantity of items' on again and observe

findings.name: "Limit of Uses" accepts a decimal and silently saves a different (truncated) number
findings.summary: Decimals are accepted with no message. Before Save the page previews a fractional cap (\"2.9 redemptions left\", \"0 of 2.9 used\") and after Save the same page shows 2 — the entered value is silently truncated to a whole number, so the cap that gets stored is not the one the user typed. (on /discounts/vouchers/add and /discounts/vouchers/{id} (Limits section))
findings.expected: A redemption cap is a whole number. The field should reject a fractional value with a message next to the field (as it does for 0 and negative values, which show \"Enter a limit of at least 1\"), or round it before showing it — the number saved must be the number the page showed before Save.
findings.actual: Decimals are accepted with no message. Before Save the page previews a fractional cap (\"2.9 redemptions left\", \"0 of 2.9 used\") and after Save the same page shows 2 — the entered value is silently truncated to a whole number, so the cap that gets stored is not the one the user typed.
reproSteps: Open https://5503-ief25m2mkkrkgto7fvk68.e2b.app/discounts/vouchers/Vm91Y2hlcjoxMA%3D%3D (the voucher "agent8-decimal-limit") and click "Limits" in the left section nav.
Turn on the toggle "Limit number of times this discount can be used in total".
Type 2.9 into the "Limit of Uses" field (the field shows no validation message; the "Uses left" hint next to it and the right-hand Redemptions card show "2.9").
Click Save and wait for the "Voucher updated" toast.
Read the Limits section again: "Limit of Uses" and "Uses left" now show 2, and the Redemptions card shows "0 of 2 used".
Same on create: at /discounts/vouchers/add with the limit on, 1.5 was accepted without any message and the saved voucher showed "Limit of Uses" 1 / "0 of 1 used".

findings.name: Save with an empty \"Limit of Uses\" fails with a 400 but still shows the success toast \"Voucher updated\"
findings.summary: Save sends the update, the server answers 400, and the page shows the green success toast \"Voucher updated\" anyway. Only the field's own inline error and the \"Unsaved changes\" note hint that nothing happened; after a reload the voucher still has the previous cap (2) — so the person is told the change saved when it did not. (on /discounts/vouchers/{id} (Limits section))
findings.expected: Save with an invalid value should be refused: no success message, an error explaining what is wrong (or Save blocked while the field shows \"Enter a limit of at least 1\"). A success toast must only appear when the change was actually persisted.
findings.actual: Save sends the update, the server answers 400, and the page shows the green success toast \"Voucher updated\" anyway. Only the field's own inline error and the \"Unsaved changes\" note hint that nothing happened; after a reload the voucher still has the previous cap (2) — so the person is told the change saved when it did not.
reproSteps: Open https://5503-ief25m2mkkrkgto7fvk68.e2b.app/discounts/vouchers/Vm91Y2hlcjoxMA%3D%3D (the voucher "agent8-decimal-limit") and click "Limits" in the left section nav.
The toggle "Limit number of times this discount can be used in total" is on with "Limit of Uses" = 2.
Clear the "Limit of Uses" field completely: it shows the red message "Enter a limit of at least 1".
Click Save at the bottom right.

Observe: a green toast "Voucher updated" appears (console: POST /graphql/ VoucherUpdate → 400 Bad Request) while the field still shows "Enter a limit of at least 1" and the bottom bar still says "Unsaved changes: General settings".
Reload the page: the Limits section still shows "Limit of Uses" 2 and the Redemptions card "0 of 2 used" — nothing was saved.

findings.name: Re-enabled column jumps to the first position in the vouchers table and the order no longer matches the Pick columns list

findings.name: Clearing Start Date silently saves the start as "now" and drops the typed Start Hour
findings.summary: The save succeeds ("Voucher updated") and the stored start date/hour is silently set to the moment of saving (shown after reload as 11/24/2026, 12:26 AM). The 09:30 that was typed in Start Hour is discarded, and the voucher — previously "Ended"/"Inactive · 2,517 days ago" for its 2020 window — silently becomes "Active". In the second attempt the page even kept showing an empty Start Date and "Unsaved changes: Schedule" after the successful save until the page was reloaded. (on /discounts/vouchers/{id})
findings.expected: An empty Start Date with an end date already gave the validation "End date cannot be before the start date"; so a cleared start date should be refused or the user warned. At minimum the hour the user typed must be kept, and the voucher's status must not change silently to Active.
findings.actual: The save succeeds ("Voucher updated") and the stored start date/hour is silently set to the moment of saving (shown after reload as 11/24/2026, 12:26 AM). The 09:30 that was typed in Start Hour is discarded, and the voucher — previously "Ended"/"Inactive · 2,517 days ago" for its 2020 window — silently becomes "Active". In the second attempt the page even kept showing an empty Start Date and "Unsaved changes: Schedule" after the successful save until the page was reloaded.
reproSteps: Sign in as admin@example.com / admin, open Discounts > Vouchers and open my voucher "agent6-past-range" (/discounts/vouchers/Vm91Y2hlcjoxNQ%3D%3D), whose Schedule is Start 01/02/2020 09:30 AM, End 01/03/2020 09:30 AM and whose status is Ended / Inactive.
In the right-hand Schedule panel type 09:30 AM into "Start Hour".
Clear the "Start Date" field so it shows mm/dd/yyyy (leave "Set end date" untouched or clear it) — the panel status changes to Active.
Click Save at the bottom right and wait for the "Voucher updated" toast.
Reload the page: the Schedule now shows Start Date 11/24/2026 and Start Hour 12:26 AM (the moment of saving), not 09:30, and the header status is Active.

findings.name: Typing a filter field name and pressing Enter leaves a dead condition row: no operator, Apply disabled
findings.summary: The field keeps the text \"Started\" as if it were selected, but the operator box stays empty, the value box stays empty and disabled, and \"Apply\" stays disabled. Clicking the operator box opens nothing (no options), so the condition can never be completed; the user has to remove the row or choose another field. Typing a field name and clicking its option in the dropdown works normally. (on /discounts/vouchers)
findings.expected: Enter behaves like choosing the option in the dropdown: the condition gets its operator (and value picker), so it can be filled and applied — or Enter does nothing at all instead of leaving a half-configured row.
findings.actual: The field keeps the text \"Started\" as if it were selected, but the operator box stays empty, the value box stays empty and disabled, and \"Apply\" stays disabled.
